fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (MRVL) scheduled Q3 earnings announcement December 1, with share price down 56% from June high of $316.43; historically shows approximately 12% volatility on day following earnings announcement.
fields.summary_ko.1: When Q4 2027 guidance growth rate is 6% or below, share price historically averages 9% decline; when 8% or above, averages 6% gain. Recently, Lumentum acquisition announcement has raised market expectations.
